title: Studio Interfaces: the nav rail and canvas list entries in array order and ignore `order`, while the running menu sorts by it
body:
Filing gate ① a product defect, measured by reading the code on `origin/main`. Found by the #26740 card thread (os-dev report 6456608083, `out_of_scope_findings` 1) while PR #26977 made `order` authorable in the Studio nav-item inspector; filed by the `domain:ui#5` seat (`session_01JQwxbXGpVJHZTXXerMoY4C`, seat post #26945).

`finding` class **a** · `reach:` Studio Interfaces, for any app whose nav entries carry `order` (authorable from Studio once PR #26977 lands; API-written today).

## What is seen

- The running menu sorts top-level entries with `byNavOrder` (`ui/packages/layout/src/navOrder.ts`, `(a.order ?? 0) - (b.order ?? 0)`).
- The Studio Interfaces rail (`NavTree` in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`) and `AppNavCanvas` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/AppNavCanvas.tsx`) list entries in array order: neither file reads `order` or `byNavOrder` (grep on `origin/main`, 0 hits).
- So an entry given `order` shows in one place in Studio and another in the published console, and a drag reorder in the rail (which reorders the array) can be overridden at runtime by `order`.

Not reproduced in a browser; the reading is the two code paths above.

## Expected

The builder sees the order the menu will show: the rail and canvas sort by the runtime's own `byNavOrder` (⛔ no second comparator), or a drag reorder rewrites `order` so the two cannot disagree. Which one is a lane call for the implementer to measure.

## Dedupe

Open `domain:ui` cards read by REST on 2026-10-27 for `order` / `byNavOrder` / rail reorder: no hit.

**Reader who acts:** the triage seat (first touch), then the Studio Interfaces pillar owner (`domain:ui`, `area:studio`).
